majorFindingsFoundAndFixed.finding: the new stale-exclusion warning printed an operator remedy that DOES NOT WORK for the content stage — prepare.ts kept the carried artifact for every non-frozen stage, discarding the freshly re-hashed lineage ref, so content never re-hashed and the warning would persist forever
majorFindingsFoundAndFixed.fix: samePath guard: carried artifact is adopted from lineage when carried.artifact.path === lineageArtifact.path. Equal paths mean the same bytes hashed two ways; a stage advanced to a NEW run dir is still protected (an unguarded 'always adopt lineage' makes both the new 27H.7f AND the pre-existing 27.35 fail).
majorFindingsFoundAndFixed.disclosedTradeoff: a re-prepare now re-baselines a same-path non-frozen artifact, so that stage's own drift signal resets. Verified by an independent probe that downstream theme/seo/production REMAIN stale, so a hand edit still propagates into the rebuild. A stricter drift-guard was designed and REJECTED with reasoning: a legacy content dir goes 'drifted' after one content:qa run, which would block the very re-hash the remedy promises.

majorFindingsFoundAndFixed.finding: FAKE-PASS: check 27H.7 was named 'the freshness warning reaches the operator through release:plan' and asserted `warnings.length === 0`. Deleting the seeding line or either WARNINGS block left smoke:release at 130/130 green. grep for `.warnings` across the 2,300-line suite returned exactly ONE line.
